schema.description: One hangover, a single day, one row in a records file (source records). A point, in no series; values are the row's own text.

date.description: The day of the hangover. Sydney local date, YYYY-MM-DD, as the records row writes it. This is the fact time.

id.description: The row id the records file assigns, chosen once and never derived from the content. This is the identity.

note.description: Free text, as the row writes it.
